features.name: Tool questions
features.note: OmpBridge hardcodes --mode rpc; upstream rpc-ui enables tool UI. A React select dialog alone does not make the native ask tool usable. rpc-ui also disables PTY, so shell behavior needs acceptance when changing modes.

features.name: Slash output and native notices
features.note: command_output and notice frames are discarded by chatReducer. Commands can run with no visible answer or error.

features.name: Dialog cancellation and selection fidelity
features.note: cancel does not remove targetId; initialIndex/checkedIndices/checkbox markers/option descriptions are dropped; input secret hints are not propagated.

features.name: Extension composer updates
features.note: set_editor_text displays a notice but does not put the supplied text into the composer.

features.name: Lossless large RPC frames
features.note: No negotiate_protocol/v2 decoder, and snapshot.ts uses unpaged get_messages. Large history/tool/extension payloads retain protocol-v1 limits.

features.name: Goal lifecycle and task editing
features.note: Display-only task plan is good; start/pause/resume/clear/budget and editable todos still need controls.

features.name: Queue management
features.note: Steer/follow-up and queued chips exist, but withdraw/promote/edit/restore operations require manual JSON.

features.name: Subagent conversations and steering
features.note: Agent list/cancel exists; child transcripts, steering and lifecycle/progress subscriptions need dedicated integration.

features.name: Export/fork/tree completion
features.note: Export path and fork result are ignored; tree navigation is limited to checkpoints/reply versions.

features.name: Provider accounts and MCP authentication
features.note: Provider logout/account selection are console-only. MCP config/probe exists, but upstream RPC does not install interactive MCP authentication handling.

features.name: Settings reachability versus effect
features.note: 615 global fields are listed; 23 enum controls have no choices, 165 fields lack UI metadata, and 167 have no tab category. TUI-only fields and RPC defaults also limit the effect of configuration.

features.name: Launch flags
features.note: Launch flags are split on whitespace, so quoted paths/arguments are not preserved. Interactive/print/output-mode flags cannot be counted as working RPC features merely because the text box accepts them.

features.name: Voice and dictation
features.note: No microphone/WebRTC/session/capture/mute UI or voice/dictation event consumers. Speech-related settings/model roles do not provide that workflow.

features.name: Word completion and side questions
features.note: No predict_word ghost text/feedback or btw streaming/history view. Project suggestions are a different host feature.

features.name: Host-owned tools and virtual URIs
features.note: No request dispatch, cancellation, update/result or URI read/write responder. Raw JSON registration alone can leave requests unanswered.

features.name: Native CLI services and administration
features.note: No profile manager, session transfer, skill registry installation/publishing, native updater/dependency installer, provider quota view, auth broker, process console or full Git UI.

features.name: Extension terminal components
features.note: Native component factories/custom header/footer/editor/raw input/autocomplete/theme APIs are terminal-only. They require an adapter or an explicitly retained terminal workflow.
